_comment: Citation for the 10e core Ruins terrain rule (INFANTRY/BEAST/SWARM may shoot through Ruin walls; all other models are blocked).

terrain.ruin_infantry_los.quoted_text: Models can shoot through walls of a Ruin so long as both the firing model and the target model have the INFANTRY, BEAST or SWARM keyword. In all other cases, a wall blocks line of sight.
terrain.ruin_infantry_los.trigger: a shooting attack's line-of-sight segment crosses a Ruin terrain rectangle whose interior contains neither the attacker nor the target
terrain.ruin_infantry_los.effect: line of sight passes through the Ruin wall iff both the attacker's unit and the target's unit carry the INFANTRY, BEAST or SWARM keyword; otherwise the wall blocks line of sight. Implemented in code.map.Map.has_line_of_sight; the keyword tuples are threaded from Battle._do_shoot (and _apply_firing_deck, _try_*_stratagem candidate scans) so the firing model's own keywords decide passage even when a TRANSPORT carries the firing position. RUIN terrain also confers Heavy Cover (+1 save, -1 to hit) via Battle._do_shoot — same combat effect as TerrainType.HEAVY_COVER, separate LoS rule.
